blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—TJ James Tejedor, Jehyan Dayagbil, and Chresler John Medina spearheaded their teams’ victories as Dumanjug, Carcar, and unbeaten Sibonga turned in strong performances in the Governor’s Cup basketball tournament over the weekend at the Sibonga Sports Complex. Tejedor delivered an all-around performance for Dumanjug. Dayagbil stuffed the stat sheet for Carcar, while Medina continued to lead Sibonga’s scoring attack in the South Group A, D, and B competitions, respectively. Dumanjug defeated Samboan, 65-52, to improve to 2-1 and take third place in South Group A. Tejedor led the winners with 18 points, nine steals, seven rebounds, and five assists […]...
